Num.15. 5familiaris, in quem conueniebant seniores singularum tribuum 2.Reg.20. & vrbanus, in quem conueniebant senatores singularum vrbium. Iudic.11.Ruth.4. Iudicia erant coetus illi, qui definiebant singularem aequitatem, quae lege prouideri aut praescribi non potuit. Erant autem alia 10ciuitatum Exod.18.Deut.1.2.Paral.19. quae exercebantur in porta cuiusque ciuitatis Deut.25. Ios.8.Ruth.3. Prou.22. alia concilij Hierosolymitani, quod inde a Mose vsque ad Herodem durauit, & vsitate appellatur Sanhedrin. Vide Deut. 17.& 19. 2.Paral.19. Magistratus erant togati, vel bellici. 15Magistratus togati praerant tempore pacis. Erant autem vel vniuersi populi, vt primò iudices, deinde reges, & tertiò post captiuitatem Principes & pontifices: vel singularum tribuum, iique tum phylarchi, principes tribuum Num.1. & 4. tum patriarchae, principes familiarum Num.26. vel singularum ciuitatum, iique chiliarchi, hecatontarchi, pentecontarchi, decarchi. h. e. praefecti 1000.100.50. vel 10. hominibus. Exod.18.Deut.1. Magistratus bellici administrabant rem bellicam. Erant autem praefecti exercitus vel politici, vel templi. Praefecti exercitus politici erant tum princeps militiae, seu imperator, & dux belli 1.Sam.14.v.50. 2.Sam.24.v.2. tum duces inferiores, puta chiliarchi, hecatontarchi &c. 1.Paral.12.&24. 2.Paral.28. main_text.p: 1. SCholastica sacra est prudentia bene con-35stituendi & regendi scholam ex praescripto S. literarum.

page.notes: Printed line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin; each is given as a note at its line. The large initial S of "Scholastica" is joined to the word. Long s is written as s throughout, so "Iof." is read as Ios. The Greek-free text has no Hebrew. Some italics in the citations are approximate. Abbreviation "Par." after "1." is read as printed and could be Par. with a bar. Running head printed as BIBLICUS. with full stop. The catchword "II. Eius" is at the right foot.
